title: Earning and Reversal of Annual Reward on Northgate Memberships
content:
Annual Reward on Northgate Memberships is earned purchase by purchase, capped for the membership year, and taken back when a rewarded purchase is refunded.

## Earning

1. Annual Reward is earned at the tier's Annual Reward rate on the tier's reward basis — the pre-tax net price after instant savings — of each qualifying order sale line and optical charge, rounded to the cent per entry.
2. Annual Reward accrues only on a membership whose tier carries a non-zero Annual Reward rate on the date of the purchase. The tier is the one on the membership record on that date.
3. Annual Reward accrues only while the membership's status is active.
4. Merchandise classes the tier excludes from Annual Reward never earn. Delivery fees, Tire Center installation and service fees, Northgate Care protection plans and membership fees are not merchandise and never earn either.
5. A purchase on a non-Plus tier earns nothing, and a later upgrade does not make it earn.

## Yearly cap

The reward of one membership year may not exceed the tier's maximum Annual Reward for one membership year. The year's net reward is the reward accrued in the current membership year less the reward reversed in it. An entry that would take the year's net reward past the cap accrues only the remaining room, and nothing accrues once the cap is reached.

## Reversal

When a qualifying purchase is returned, price-adjusted, rebated or refunded, the reward on the refunded amount is reversed at the rate the original entry earned, and the reversal is never more than the reward on that original line not yet reversed, and never more than the current Annual Reward balance. The reversal is booked in the membership year in which the refund happens, and a refund that falls after the original year's certificate was issued reduces the current year's balance instead.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, on a Plus tier earning 2.0 percent; non-Plus tiers earn at 0)

| Situation | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Qualifying line, reward basis 412.37 | 2.0 percent of 412.37 is 8.2474, rounded to the cent | 8.25 accrued |
| Year's net reward stands 3.00 below the cap; next line would earn 8.00 | only the remaining room accrues | 3.00 accrued |
| Year's net reward already at the cap | no room remains | nothing accrued |
| Line that earned 6.00 on a basis of 300.00; 150.00 of it refunded; balance 40.00 | 2.0 percent of 150.00 is 3.00; not more than the 6.00 not yet reversed, nor the 40.00 balance | 3.00 reversed |
| Same line, refund of 300.00, current balance 2.50 | 6.00 on the refund, limited to the balance | 2.50 reversed |
| Gasoline purchase on a Plus tier | excluded class | nothing accrued |
| Purchase while the membership is expired | status not active | nothing accrued |
